_comment: Followed teams (shown first, in this order) per section. Add a team here and rebuild; no code changes are needed. Names must match the official feed's spelling (see README).

fallbackGrounds._comment: Used only when the official feed has no stadium name for a club. Any use is flagged in the Before you travel notes.

cymruNorthGrounds._comment: faw.cymru does not list venues. Postcodes are shown only for the followed teams' home games. Anything not listed here shows 'Postcode not found'.

Holyhead Hotspur.caveat: LL65 2YE is less certain: it is believed to be the postcode of the leisure centre opposite the ground.

Brickfield Rangers.caveat: LL14 4HE for Clywedog Park comes from a single source.

cymruNorthSlugNames._comment: Optional. faw.cymru match-URL club slug -> display name, for clubs whose title-cased slug is not how they are known. Rhyl 1879 and Bangor City 1876 are built in.

aliases._comment: Lower-case spelling used by a source -> canonical club name. Only needed where a source's name is not a plain prefix of the official name.
